operations.summary: Create a site-bound HMAC-SHA256 URL authentication policy
operations.summary_zh: 创建绑定网站的 HMAC-SHA256 URL 鉴权策略
operations.description: An enabled policy is delivered to the scope's nodes that declare URL_AUTH with the write; they verify signed URLs before the cache and answer 503 until the policy is installed. Without the edge publication runtime an enabled policy returns 422 url_auth_unavailable and nothing is created. Requires url_auth_policies.manage. The generated key secret is returned exactly once on the first successful request. An identical idempotent replay returns the same policy with replayed=true and no secret. Legacy Type A, Type B, and MD5 are migration provenance only and cannot be selected for new execution. This endpoint records a deterministic edge-compatible snapshot but does not publish it to Gateway or an edge node.
operations.description_zh: 启用的策略随写入下发到声明 URL_AUTH 的节点，节点在缓存之前验签；未下发到的节点返回 503，不放行。 主控未开启边缘发布时，创建启用的策略返回 422 url_auth_unavailable，不创建策略。

responses.description: Policy, revision-one snapshot, and first-response-only key secret.

operations.description: A write that leaves the policy enabled is delivered to its nodes again; without the edge publication runtime a body with enabled=true returns 422 url_auth_unavailable and leaves the policy unchanged.
